attempts.name: Unresolved_c47f0027
attempts.notes: Hoisted msg.data into a local `bytes calldata data` before the assembly blocks, since inline assembly cannot reference msg.data directly in Solidity 0.8.30. Both mload expressions now use `data` instead; the calldata pointer arithmetic (add(data, 0x24) + arg0) is unchanged, matching the original byte-offset intent (0x20 header + 0x04 selector + arg0). No other logic was altered.

attempts.name: Unresolved_c47f0027
attempts.notes: Hoisted calldata access out of inline assembly: `data` is a `bytes calldata` local, so `mload(add(data, ...))` is invalid (error 1397). Replaced each with `calldatacopy(0x00, add(add(data.offset, 0x20), arg0), 0x20)` followed by `mload(0x00)`, preserving the original word load at `data + 0x24 + arg0` (0x20 into the payload plus arg0). All other logic, storage updates, and the event are unchanged.
